target.description: Default target used when --mc, --loader, --loader-version or --side are not given.

side.description: Installation the pack is for: client, server (dedicated server) or both (default). Mods not needed on that side are left out of migrated packs.

ignore.description: Mods left out of the analysis and of migrated packs: file name ("*" wildcard allowed), Modrinth slug or project id.

exclude.description: Mods that are analysed and reported but left out of migrated packs: file name ("*" wildcard allowed), Modrinth slug or project id.

mappings.description: Manual replacements: source mod (file name, Modrinth slug or project id) → Modrinth project (slug or id) to use for the target.
